summary: SERTEX mobile FAZ A parity build tested end-to-end via Expo web preview (mobile viewport 390x900). Task Detail screen and Category Management screen — all flows verified with real mutations on preview DB. Cleanup complete (no TESTQA leftovers).

ui_bugs.issue: After a hard-reload on /task/[id] (browser refresh) followed by delete, router.back() is a no-op because the navigation stack is empty, so the user is left on a stale task-detail page after the DELETE API succeeds. Repro: open task detail via list → reload the page → tap delete → confirm. Delete succeeds server-side but UI does not navigate to the tasks list. On a normal in-app forward navigation (list → detail → delete) the back navigation works correctly.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning during login: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a react-native-web component surface (e.g. safe-area / gesture wrapper). Not blocking, but should be migrated to style.pointerEvents. Reference: seen in browser console on route change.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/mobile/app/task/[id].tsx doDelete(), fall back to router.replace('/(tabs)/tasks') if router.canGoBack() is false, so a direct-URL / reloaded detail page still returns to the tasks list after delete.
OPTIONAL: Track down the deprecated `pointerEvents` prop warning and migrate to `style.pointerEvents`.
critical_code_review_comments: task/[id].tsx: doDelete uses router.back() unconditionally — a defensive router.replace fallback would harden the deep-link/refresh case.
CategoryEditorModal.tsx: the company search TextInput has no testID (only the chip results do). Consider adding one to make future tests less reliant on positional selectors.
CategoryEditorModal.tsx move-target list intentionally excludes descendants (good — prevents cyclic parenting). Verified by inspection.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up: 1 TESTQA task ('TESTQA Detail Task' → renamed 'TESTQA Detail Task Edited') deleted; 1 TESTQA subtask added and deleted; 1 TESTQA root category ('TESTQA Root' → renamed 'TESTQA Root Renamed') deleted; 1 TESTQA sub category ('TESTQA Sub') created, moved to root, and deleted. Preview DB left clean — verified: category list shows only original Fason Verme + Kargolama.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile FAZ A (Task Detail + Category Manager) is functionally complete. Every testID in DETAIL and CATMGR registries responds correctly. When automating modals in Expo web preview at 390x844 viewport, some buttons (e.g. task-form-save-button, task-detail-delete-confirm, category-editor-save-button, category-delete-confirm) can land outside the strict viewport used by Playwright — using `element.evaluate('el => el.click()')` reliably clicks them without needing to grow the viewport. Persistence of subtasks and reminder chips was verified by hard-reloading the detail route (~1s bundle re-hydrate) and re-inspecting DOM.
rca of the issue: The single UX gap (post-reload delete does not navigate away) is caused by expo-router's history stack being empty after a hard page reload on a deep route; `router.back()` has nowhere to pop to and becomes a no-op. Fix by guarding with `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/(tabs)/tasks')`.
